tool.title: curve (rappture2web)
tool.about:
Example of a Rappture <curve> object.
Curves are a list of (x,y) data points, representing discrete samples of a function y(x).
When you click the Simulate button, the inputs will be used to generate output curves.

about.label: Number of points
about.description: Determines the number of data points in all output curves.
